title: npm download cache
why: Download cache can be recreated by npm.
restore_note: npm repopulates this cache as needed.

title: uv package cache
why: uv owns cache cleanup; check for active consumers.
restore_note: uv downloads packages again when needed.

title: pip download cache
why: pip cache contains rebuildable package downloads.
restore_note: pip downloads packages again when needed.

title: Hermes regent uv package cache
why: Owner-authorized exact profile package cache; uv owns cleanup and active consumers block it.
restore_note: uv repopulates this profile cache as needed.

title: Homebrew cleanup dry-run report
why: Read-only report of cache size and Homebrew cleanup dry-run; the manual cleanup can also remove old versions and autoremove dependencies.
restore_note: Report only. Review brew cleanup --dry-run output before choosing the broader manual brew cleanup action.

title: Playwright browser cache
why: Browser runtimes are large and can be reinstalled, but projects may depend on them.
restore_note: Move the recorded trash_path from ~/.Trash back to the original path manually; Finder Put Back is unavailable.

title: Xcode DerivedData
why: Build products are reproducible; active builds must not be disturbed.
restore_note: Move the recorded trash_path from ~/.Trash back to the original path manually; Finder Put Back is unavailable.

title: Xcode iOS DeviceSupport
why: Downloaded device symbols can be fetched again but may be needed for debugging older devices.
restore_note: Move the recorded trash_path from ~/.Trash back to the original path manually; Finder Put Back is unavailable.

title: Stale npm _npx packages
why: Cached package executions are rebuildable; active process references must block cleanup.
restore_note: Move the recorded trash_path from ~/.Trash back to the original path manually; Finder Put Back is unavailable.

title: Chrome cache
why: Only the cache directory is in scope; refuse while Chrome is using it.
restore_note: Move the recorded trash_path from ~/.Trash back to the original path manually; Finder Put Back is unavailable.

title: Hermes profile development caches
why: Remaining per-profile developer caches are review-only; the four owner-authorized native package caches and all model/index paths are excluded.
restore_note: Move the recorded trash_path from ~/.Trash back to the original path manually; Finder Put Back is unavailable.

title: Time Machine local snapshots (report only)
why: The cleanup engine never deletes APFS snapshots; list one exact date and show a manual command only.
restore_note: A future Time Machine backup creates new snapshots; deleted snapshot history cannot be restored.
